name: app-it
description: Turn local web projects or hosted web URLs into macOS Dock apps on a local agent host.

interface.shortDescription: Web apps in your macOS Dock
interface.longDescription: App It helps a local coding agent create and install a macOS .app that opens a local web project or hosted web URL in a native WebKit window. It uses bundled templates to build the launcher, choose ports, keep local servers warm after window close, and stop only owned servers on quit. Requires a local macOS host, shell and file access, Apple command line tools, Python 3, and the project runtime. Cloud-only ChatGPT, iOS, Windows and Linux execution are not supported. Generated apps are for personal use; distribution and notarization are not included.
defaultPrompt: Make this local web project launchable from my macOS Dock.
Wrap this hosted web URL in a local macOS app.
Verify this App It launcher and its server cleanup.
